clue.text: The oceans supply a source of power

definitions.meaning: the main is a poetic word for the open sea, so the oceans are the high seas
the domestic electricity supply from the grid

explanation.surface: A claim that the seas could be tapped for energy.
explanation.definitionFit: Poets call the open sea the main, and the household electricity supply is also called by this plural word.

clue.text: Instruction to lay more off

definitions.meaning: a period of teaching
to put more off is to put ..., read as two words

explanation.surface: Advice to someone to cut back on what they pile on.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition splits the answer into LESS ON: laying more off means laying less on.
explanation.definitionFit: A school class is a period of teaching, and laying less on is the same as taking more off.

clue.text: Two fools take in a murderer

indicators.note: the number tells us to write the fools word twice in a row

parts.note: an ass is a fool
taken as written

explanation.surface: A pair of idiots give shelter to a killer.
explanation.definitionFit: An assassin is a killer, especially of a prominent person.

clue.text: Got up, had a meal and was in thepink

parts.note: rose is the past tense of rise, to get up
ate means had a meal

explanation.surface: Someone rose, breakfasted and felt in perfect health.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In the pink' suggests good health, but here it is literal: rose-coloured.
explanation.definitionFit: Roseate means rosy-coloured, a pale pink shade.

clue.text: Mad enough to break the saucepan

parts.note: to crack is to break
a pot is a cooking pan

explanation.surface: Someone angry enough to smash the kitchen pans.
explanation.definitionFit: A crackpot is an eccentric or crazy person, used here as an adjective meaning crazy.

clue.text: Main message broadcast to children

definitions.meaning: a flag signal at sea (the main): the flag raised to show a ship is about to sail
a long-running BBC children's television programme

explanation.surface: A nautical signal relayed to youngsters.
explanation.definitionFit: The blue-and-white flag hoisted before sailing shares its name with a famous British children's TV show.

clue.text: Photograph what the armed bandit may do

definitions.meaning: to photograph is to snap a picture

definitions.text: what the armed bandit may do
definitions.meaning: a gunman may fire his gun

explanation.surface: A camera and a gun both 'shoot'.
explanation.definitionFit: Shooting a picture and shooting a gun share one phrase meaning to fire or snap.

clue.text: Material for military exercises

definitions.meaning: a strong twilled cotton fabric
parade-ground training for soldiers

explanation.surface: Fabric used for soldiers' training.
explanation.definitionFit: Drill is a hard-wearing cotton cloth and also soldiers' marching practice.

clue.text: Many a politician is wet

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500, a large number
MP stands for Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A claim that lots of politicians are feeble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wet' in British slang means feeble, which the surface plays on; the definition is the literal sense, moist.
explanation.definitionFit: Something slightly moist is described by this word.

clue.text: Where the citizen has a right to be tense

definitions.text: Where the citizen has a right to be
definitions.meaning: a citizen belongs within a nation
agitated or anxious

explanation.surface: Musing on a citizen's rights, with a grammatical aside.
explanation.definitionFit: A citizen lives within a nation, and someone flustered is said to be worked up in this way.

clue.text: One of the toxophilists of Ambridge

definitions.meaning: a toxophilite is a lover of archery, so one of them shoots a bow
Ambridge is the village in the BBC radio soap about a farming family of this name

explanation.surface: An archery enthusiast from a fictional village.
explanation.definitionFit: A bowman, and also a member of the family in the long-running BBC Radio 4 soap set in Ambridge.

clue.text: Where to lay our responsibility

parts.note: the place we lay a duty is upon ourselves, which split as two words gives a word for a burden

explanation.surface: A question of who should carry the blame.
explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer as ON US: it is where we lay a burden, and the whole word means burden.
explanation.definitionFit: A duty or burden someone must bear.

clue.text: The fastest and best stuff to get high on

parts.note: top means best
speed is slang for amphetamine

explanation.surface: Drug talk about the finest stimulant.
explanation.definitionFit: Maximum velocity is the fastest rate something can go.

clue.text: Pharmacist may provide such a container

definitions.meaning: a chemist who makes up prescriptions
a device that releases set amounts, like a soap holder

explanation.surface: A chemist who supplies medicine in a pack.
explanation.definitionFit: A chemist hands out medicines, and a device that releases measured amounts shares the name.

clue.text: The result of a bombshell in recent City practices

definitions.meaning: the loud explosion when a bomb goes off
the 1986 deregulation of the London Stock Exchange (the City)

explanation.surface: Shocking news upending financial dealings.
explanation.definitionFit: A huge explosion, and the nickname for the 1986 shake-up of London's financial district, known as the City.

clue.text: He sings the first few notes with sonorous quality

parts.note: a bar of music holds a few notes
I is the Roman numeral one
tone is the quality of a sound

explanation.surface: A singer opening with a rich, resonant phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: A male singer whose voice lies between tenor and bass.

clue.text: Colonist who is fully paid up

definitions.meaning: a pioneer who takes up land in a new country
one who settles a bill pays it

explanation.surface: A pioneer who owes nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: A pioneer making a home in new territory, and someone who clears a debt.

clue.text: Eton is an unusual place to find an Eastern European

indicators.note: unusual signals that these letters come in an odd order

explanation.surface: Finding a Baltic native at the elite English school would be rare.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unusual' rearranges ETON IS AN. Eton is a famous English private school.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of Estonia, a Baltic state in eastern Europe.

clue.text: Once more a righteous man is in opposition

parts.note: again means once more
ST is the abbreviation for saint, a holy person

explanation.surface: A good man takes a contrary stance again.
explanation.definitionFit: Being opposed to something means standing contrary to it.

clue.text: Just playing the game

definitions.meaning: fair and generous
taking part in sport

explanation.surface: Merely joining in.
explanation.definitionFit: A fair-minded opponent is generous, and someone taking part in a sport is active in it.

clue.text: African tribesmen, each claiming to be sanctimonious

parts.note: each would say 'I am', contracted
pi is slang for pious or sanctimonious

explanation.surface: Tribesmen all professing their own holiness.
explanation.walkthrough: Each tribesman says I'M PI. An impi is a Zulu regiment.
explanation.definitionFit: A body of Zulu warriors.

clue.text: Instant credit

definitions.meaning: a moment, as in 'just a moment'
buying on account, British informal

explanation.surface: Immediate loans.
explanation.definitionFit: A moment is British slang 'a second', and buying 'on' this means buying on credit.

clue.text: Hazel carries it to puss and her kittens

parts.note: a cat is a puss
a mother's kittens are her kin

explanation.surface: Someone named Hazel bringing something to a cat and her litter.
explanation.walkthrough: Hazel looks like a woman's name; it is the tree, which bears these flowers.
explanation.definitionFit: The hazel tree bears dangling flower spikes called lambs' tails.

clue.text: Coal burning fast on such days

definitions.meaning: a glowing bit of fuel in a dying fire
... days are Christian days of fasting and prayer

explanation.surface: Fuel glowing during fasting days.
explanation.definitionFit: A glowing remnant of a fire, and the church's quarterly fasting days.

clue.text: Part of the foot regiments should be on parade

definitions.meaning: the arched middle of the foot
marching together in time

explanation.surface: Soldiers' feet and their marching.
explanation.definitionFit: The arch of the foot, and troops marching in time are said to keep step.

clue.text: Never instantaneously

definitions.meaning: at no moment at all, read literally
very quickly

explanation.surface: Contradictory timing.
explanation.definitionFit: Read literally the phrase means at no moment, but idiomatically it means very quickly.

clue.text: Intends to make money

definitions.meaning: plans or has in mind
wealth or resources

explanation.surface: Planning to earn cash.
explanation.definitionFit: To intend is to have in mind, and a person of resources has wealth.

clue.text: Restaurant where I meet Stan by arrangement

indicators.note: by arrangement means these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Agreeing to meet a friend at a diner.
explanation.definitionFit: A small French cafe selling food and drink.
